card.name: Electrical safety maintenance guidance wording
card.fires_on: Ordinary words inside UK electrical-safety and installation guidance, especially the maintenance and inspection passage ("Carry out preventative maintenance", "installations should be maintained"). It also fires weakly on scattered words in other practical how-to text.
